c74object.name: el.splitbank~
c74object.digest: Spectral bin splitter with multi-channel oscillator-bank resynthesis
c74object.description:
el.splitbank~ decomposes an incoming audio spectrum into a specified number of derived spectral bands (from 2 to 64 channels, must be a power of 2) and resynthesizes each band using an independent oscillator bank. Each output channel can be independently transposed and tuned in real time via dedicated signal inlets. Spectral bins can be dynamically scrambled across channels (scramble), explicitly mapped (setstate), stored and recalled from presets (store, recall), and morphed smoothly using linear or equal-power crossfades (ramptime, powerfade). A manual control inlet enables hand-controlled interpolation between states when manual_override is active.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / messages): Sound input to be spectrally analyzed and split, as well as control message inlet (scramble, store, recall, setstate, ramptime, minfreq, maxfreq, mute, etc.).
Inlets 2 to N+1 (signal): Transposition multipliers for each output channel (1.0 = original pitch, 2.0 = octave up, etc.).
Inlet N+2 (signal): Synthesis amplitude threshold. Bins below this amplitude level are skipped during resynthesis.
Inlet N+3 (signal): Table offset factor. Shifts the spectral distribution table.
Inlet N+4 (signal): Bin offset factor. Applies a rotational bin offset across the spectrum.
Inlet N+5 [Rightmost Inlet] (signal): Manual interpolation control (0.0 to 1.0). Morphs between the previous and current bin distributions when manual_override is enabled.
Outlets
Outlets 1 to N (signal): Resynthesized audio outputs for each spectral segment channel.
Outlet N+1 [Second to Rightmost Outlet] (signal): Ramp sync signal. Outputs a normalized ramp from 0.0 to 1.0 tracking interpolation progress between states.
Rightmost Outlet (list): Current bin state list. Emits the active bin distribution mapping when queried with showstate.

inlet.description: Audio signal to be spectrally split, as well as state, routing, and configuration messages.
Pitch/speed transposition factor for each respective output channel.
Amplitude threshold below which spectral bins are omitted from resynthesis.
Shifts the channel assignment mapping across the wavetable.
Applies a rotational bin offset across the spectrum.
Crossfade position between previous and current spectral distributions when manual_override is active.

outlet.description: Resynthesized audio signal outputs for each channel.
Normalized phase signal tracking interpolation progress between distribution states.
Emits the current bin mapping list when queried via showstate.

objarg.name: output-channels
objarg.description: The number of output channels to create (default: 2, range: 2 to 64). Must be a power of 2.

method.name: fftinfo
method.description: Prints current FFT size, overlap factor, and hop size in samples to the Max Console.

method.name: manual_override
method.description: When set to 1, automatic timed interpolation is paused and crossfading between states is driven manually by the rightmost signal inlet. When set to 0 (default), interpolation uses ramptime.

method.name: maxfreq
method.description: Sets the upper frequency boundary in Hertz for oscillator bank resynthesis (default: 15,000 Hz).

method.name: minfreq
method.description: Sets the lower frequency boundary in Hertz for oscillator bank resynthesis (default: 0.0 Hz).

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence across all channels. When set to 0 (default), normal resynthesis resumes.

method.name: overlap
method.description: Sets the analysis overlap factor (default: 8, range: 2 to 64). Must be a power of 2. Takes effect upon the next DSP recompile.

method.name: powerfade
method.description: When set to 1, crossfading between spectral distribution states uses an equal-power curve. When set to 0 (default), a linear ramp is used.

method.name: ramptime
method.description: Sets the time in milliseconds to morph between spectral states (default: 1000.0 ms).

method.name: recall
method.description: Recalls a preset bin mapping stored in memory slot slot-index (0 to 1023) and begins interpolation.

method.name: scramble
method.description: Permutes all spectral bins randomly among the output channels and initiates crossfade interpolation.

method.name: setstate
method.description: Sets the exact destination channel mapping for all spectral bins. The list length must equal half of the FFT size.

method.name: showstate
method.description: Dumps the current bin distribution mapping as a list out the rightmost outlet.

method.name: store
method.description: Saves the current bin distribution into memory slot slot-index (0 to 1023).

method.name: signal
method.description: Signal arriving at inlet 1 is the audio to be spectrally split. Signals arriving at subsequent inlets control transpositions, threshold, offsets, and manual crossfading at audio rate.
